notes: Source: official Bosch/RTS Technical Data Sheet, Form No. F.01U.345.089 Rev 08 (Sept 2023), fetched directly as PDF from products.rtsintercoms.com and read in full (includes rear-panel line drawing plus complete electrical spec tables). ODIN ships as port-count-licensed SKUs (ODIN16/32/64/128NOCORD) but all tiers share the identical 1RU hardware frame and physical I/O described here (up to 128 ports/frame, up to 1024 across 8 chained frames) - licensing only gates how many are active, not what's physically present. Two power inlets (PS1/PS2) inferred from the front-panel PS1/PS2 power-button silkscreen paired with "2 connectors, fully redundant load-sharing power supplies" in the spec; exact rear-inlet silkscreen text wasn't independently legible in the source line drawing. The 24-pin General Purpose I/O terminal block is modeled as a single bidirectional euroblock port (physically one connector housing 4 relay outputs + 4 opto inputs) rather than split into two connector entries. OMNEO ports and the Inter-Frame Link both also support optional SFP fiber modules (Finisar FTLF8519P3BNL multimode 500m/2.125Gbps, or FTLF1421P1BTL single-mode 15km/2.67Gbps); Inter-Frame Link SFP cages are itemized (x4, fixed fiber-only), OMNEO fiber is an alternate/optional module on the same two ports rather than a separate physical connector. No HDMI/SDI/video connectors exist on this unit - it is a pure audio intercom matrix.

ports.name: PS1 AC In
ports.note: Locking IEC 320 C14 inlet; 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, one of two redundant load-sharing power supplies (0.5A/0.35A, 47W total typ.).

ports.name: PS2 AC In
ports.note: Locking IEC 320 C14 inlet; second of two redundant load-sharing power supplies.

ports.name: PORT1
ports.note: AIO 4-wire analog intercom port (x16, PORT1-PORT16): differential RX/TX audio + RS-485 control data over RJ-45 - analog audio, not Ethernet. 568B/USOC wiring, 24-bit A/D-D/A.

ports.name: 2W Party Line 1
ports.note: 2-wire analog partyline; software-selectable RTS CH1/CH2, Audiocom (balanced, 300 ohm), or Clear-Com (unbalanced, 200 ohm).

ports.name: 2W Party Line 2
ports.note: 2-wire analog partyline; software-selectable RTS CH1/CH2, Audiocom, or Clear-Com.

ports.name: General Purpose I/O
ports.note: 24-pin locking terminal block: 4x SPDT relay outputs (1A @ 30VDC, C/NC/NO) + 4x optically-coupled inputs (5-12VDC on A+, K to chassis ground activates).

ports.name: PAP/LCP/GPIO Port
ports.note: RS-485 control data only - no audio, no Ethernet.

ports.name: Inter-Frame Link Uplink 1
ports.note: SFP fiber, 2Gbps proprietary link for chaining up to 8 ODIN frames into a single up-to-1024-port matrix. Multimode (500m/2.125Gbps) or single-mode (15km/2.67Gbps) modules.

ports.name: Sync In
ports.note: Word Clock sync input, 75 ohm termination, 48kHz +/-25ppm, 5V TTL compatible - not an SDI video signal, so no SDI grade applies.

ports.name: OMNEO Primary
ports.note: OMNEO audio-network port, copper 100/1000Mbps, IEEE 802.3. Optional SFP fiber module available in place of copper (not separately itemized).
